title: National Day
subtitle: 考点：节日 / 一般现在时 / celebrate
passage: On October 1st, we celebrate National Day. It is a meaningful day for all Chinese people. Every year, the city is full of red flags. Many families go to the square and take photos.
My family has dinner together at home. In the evening, we watch the fireworks. The red flag is a symbol of our country. We love it.
vocab: National Day 国庆节 · celebrate 庆祝 · meaningful 有意义的 · take photos 拍照 · symbol 象征 · celebration 庆典 · village 村庄
